jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled frontend developer to join our team. You will be responsible for building and maintaining user interfaces for our web applications.
requirements: Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description: We are seeking a talented backend developer to help us build scalable and efficient server-side applications. You will work closely with our frontend team to deliver high-quality software.
requirements: Strong knowledge of Node.js and Express

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for a versatile full stack developer who can work on both frontend and backend development. You will be responsible for building end-to-end solutions for our clients.
requirements: Proficient in both frontend and backend technologies
Experience with React, Node.js, and databases
Ability to work independently and in a team

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: We are seeking a creative UI/UX designer to help us create visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces for our web and mobile applications.
requirements: Strong portfolio showcasing UI/UX design skills
Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: We are looking for a data scientist to analyze and interpret complex data sets. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams to derive insights and make data-driven decisions.
requirements: Strong knowledge of statistics and machine learning
Experience with Python or R for data analysis
